title: serving-runtime daily scratchpad 2026-03-09
content:
Quick notes / running log - 2026-03-09
Owner: Samira Khan (serving-runtime)
Context: triaging performance regressions observed in canary for v0.9.7-alpha; some tail-latency spikes and increased mem usage on p4d nodes.

Top priorities:
- [ ] Reproduce tail-latency spike locally with nightly load runner (use dataset: chat-small, seq_len=1024)
- [ ] Validate KV-cache eviction logic: suspect stale-invalidation when rollouts switch model variants
- [ ] Patch/validate kernel selection path for fused-attn on ampere gen GPUs (possible mismatch for seq_len 512->1024)
- [ ] Add histogram metrics for KV cache hits per-request (bucketed by prompt_prefix_len)

Observations from canary logs (03-08 22:00 -> 03-09 04:00):
- p4d-03: 95p latency increased from 120ms -> 420ms for some 1.5% of requests; correlated with heavy multi-tenant bursts
- mem/rss climb ~+1.1GB over 15m on worker processes after model switch; OOM not reached but GC thrashing seen in logs
- cache hit-rate drops from 78% -> 35% for long-tail user prompts (prefix length > 300 tokens)

Initial hypotheses:
1) Batching thresholds changed unintentionally in autoscaler config for dedicated lanes -> higher queueing + tail spikes
2) KV-cache eviction policy uses absolute token-count rather than prompt-relative -> eviction churn for long prefixes
3) Kernel fallback path not picking optimized fused-attn for certain model shims -> falling back to slower kernel

Immediate action items (who/when):
- Samira: run local repro with load-runner today (03-09) morning, attach flamegraphs (GH-ops/PR#1423)
- Ethan: review autoscaler commit 7c9b2ea (deploy conf) + check per-lane batching thresholds (due EOD)
- Priya: instrument KV-cache metrics and add simple eviction counter (small change, canary by 03-10)

Debug checklist / commands:
- Start load runner: ./tools/loadrunner/run.py --model redwood/redwood-7b --seq 1024 --qps 250 --duration 30m --trace
- Collect pprof: ./scripts/collect_pprof.sh p4d-03 9091 > pprof-$(date +%s).pb.gz
- Dump KV-cache stats via admin API: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://canary-admin.int/api/v1/cache/stats
- Enable detailed kernel logging: echo "TRACE_KERNEL=1" > /etc/redwood/runtime_env && systemctl restart redwood-runtime

Notes about kernel path:
- Suspect codepath: runtime/kernel_selection.cc -> select_optimal_kernel_for_model()
- Look for conditions that force fallback: if(seq_len >= 512 && is_ampere && quant_type == Q4_0) { ... }
- Validate that quant_type is detected correctly for model-variant v0.9.7-alpha (GH-ops/PR#1423 mentions quant detection tweak)

Misc TODOs / follow-ups:
- Add unit test for eviction policy with variable prefix lengths (Samira)
- Add canary alert to trigger when KV cache hit-rate drops > 20% in 5m window (Priya)
- Postmortem draft if regression persists after fixes (timeline + perf diffs)

Meeting notes (standup 2026-03-09):
- Ethan: autoscaler tweak rolled back to previous commit; investigating threshold math
- Priya: instrumentation PR open, small API change needed for admin metrics
- Samira: repro runs scheduled, will attach traces to GH issue

Scratch / thoughts:
- Could a model variant pinning/lifecycle event cause double-writes to KV index, causing GC pressure? Check lifecycle hooks in rollout controller.
- Consider temporary mitigation: serve compatible smaller model variant for long-prefix traffic or increase cache capacity on canary lanes.

Relevant links / pointers:
- GH-ops/PR#1423 (kernel detection + perf traces)
- JIRA-RT-889 (canary regression incident)
- Confluence: serving-runtime/kv-cache-design (notes + diagrams)

End of scratchpad for 2026-03-09.

---
Small personal TODOs:
- Ping infra for extra p4d slot for extended repro (ticketed)
- Clean up local temp traces by EOD
- Write short summary for weekly eng sync if we confirm root cause
